title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: Right groin and upper thigh from above, patient supine, seen from the foot of the bed: head at the top, lateral on the image left, medial on the right. Draped, with a window over the groin.
teachingPoint: Linear probe transverse at the inguinal crease, just below the inguinal ligament, with the femoral artery under its medial end; needle in-plane from lateral, entering just beyond the probe's lateral end.
claims: Right groin from above, seen from the foot of the bed: head at the top, lateral left, medial right - the same way round as the anatomy plate.
Purple: the ASIS, the pubic tubercle and the inguinal ligament between them (dashed). Red dashes: the surface course of the femoral artery from the mid-inguinal point down the thigh.
Linear probe transverse at the inguinal crease, just below the ligament, lateral to the femoral artery, which runs under its medial end.
Needle in line with the probe, entering just beyond its lateral end (in-plane from lateral).
Three labels: ASIS, Inguinal ligament, Femoral artery.
